summary: Kerb beside open reserve on a quiet street, with homes 20-25 m away.
reasons: Houses about 20 m on both sides
Quiet residential street, one car parked

best_section.where: Market Street North, east kerb at the south end beside the grass reserve

drivers.seclusion: East side is open grass and trees; house on the same side about 20 m off at the north end and homes about 25 m across the road. No mapped buildings, so judged from imagery.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street about two cars wide; grass verge on the east gives room to pull partly off.
drivers.convention: One car parked on this kerb; some parking habit but not established.

flags: Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, drain 26 m away
Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the east side shades the lane in the afternoon; open to the north.
